one_liner_zh: 麥當勞EPS超預期、營收年增9.44%，品牌韌性與價值策略奏效。
one_liner_en: McDonald's beat EPS with 9.44% revenue growth, as brand resilience and value strategy paid off.
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：營收年增9.44%與EPS超標顯示價值策略成功喚回流量，消費降級環境下品牌防禦性突出。短中期股價有同店銷售改善與穩定股利支撐，23.70倍本益比相對合理。中期須觀察價值促銷是否侵蝕利潤。追蹤指標：全球與美國同店銷售、來客數對客單價拆解、數位與外送營收佔比、加盟商獲利健康度，以及全年同店銷售指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: 9.44% revenue growth and an EPS beat show the value strategy is recovering traffic, with the brand standing out defensively amid trade-down. Near to mid-term, the stock is supported by comparable-sales improvement and a stable dividend, with a 23.70x P/E that is reasonable. Mid-term, watch whether value promotions erode margins. Track: global and U.S. comparable sales, traffic-versus-ticket split, digital and delivery revenue mix, franchisee profit health, and full-year comparable-sales guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 2.83美元，超越預期2.74美元，正向驚喜3.11%
營收65.2億美元，年增9.44%顯示需求回穩
價值餐與數位／外送會員推動來客回升
加盟為主的輕資產模式維持高利潤與穩定現金流
highlights_en: EPS of $2.83 beat the $2.74 estimate, a 3.11% positive surprise
Revenue of $6.52B grew 9.44%, signaling demand stabilization
Value menus and digital/delivery loyalty drove traffic recovery
Franchise-led asset-light model sustains high margins and steady cash flow
risks_zh: 通膨壓抑低收入消費者外食頻率
國際市場地緣與抵制風險干擾同店銷售
食材與人力成本上升壓縮加盟商利潤
risks_en: Inflation curbs dining frequency among lower-income consumers
Geopolitical and boycott risks disrupt international comparable sales
Rising food and labor costs squeeze franchisee margins
